before.fault: Unchanged stored hashes allowed contradictory matching-provenance claims after payload/indexed-field changes; non-object stored payloads could raise comparison errors.
before.scope: Synthetic corruption in a disposable database or in-memory records against the previous committed implementation; no working-data corruption established.

correction: A shared, single contents-consistency check gates both provenance and rule comparison; non-object payloads fail closed without echoing content.
limits: Known-rule behavior unchanged: 15/15 development, 16/16 contracts, 0/3 broader probes.
This checks ordinary stored consistency, not independent source truth or resistance to a trusted database administrator.
No working data rewritten, migration, lab startup, Windows restart, remote service or public publication.
Disposable SQLite, HTTP export and mocked Node tests; no PostgreSQL concurrency or new signed-in visual proof.
